terms.name: base
terms.meaning: The robot's base origin: the one body point a hallway scenario tracks. Its position is read at each recorded sample.
terms.frame: The hallway world frame: x along the route, y sideways with the centreline at y = 0, z up from the floor.
terms.units: metres for position, seconds for sample time

nominal.rule: The base position has no per-robot nominal. A scenario states places (exit, centreline) and numbers, not a nominal.

sources: livingproof-evaluator-scenario checks.py: exit crossing and distance from the route, from the base point of each trace sample (x, y)
robot-capability-specs walk-hallway README: places, not axes (the body point is the base origin)

terms.name: base height
terms.meaning: How high the base origin is above the floor. The hallway grades its lowest value over the trial.
terms.frame: The hallway world frame, measured up from the floor (z = 0).

nominal.rule: Each robot configuration profile carries nominal_base_height, the measured standing base height in metres. The hallway evaluator grades min_base_height against fall_base_height, a separate per-configuration value in metres from the same profile, and does not compute it from nominal_base_height. A step may state a fraction of nominal, as the example step stay-upright does (60% of nominal).

sources: livingproof-evaluator-scenario checks.py: fail_less grades min_base_height against fall_height

terms.name: body contact
terms.meaning: Any contact between any part of the robot and a hallway wall. Each contact has its wall, a start time, an end time and a depth, the penetration at real-geometry signed distance at or below zero.
terms.frame: The hallway world: the wall is named (wall-left or wall-right) and times run from the start of the trial.
terms.units: depth in metres, start and end in seconds

nominal.rule: Body contact has no per-robot nominal. The hallway rule is that no contact is recorded, a limit of zero.

sources: livingproof-evaluator-scenario checks.py: fail_not_empty reads wall_contacts, the hallway metric for this term
robot-capability-specs walk-hallway README: wall_contacts must be empty
